affected_subject.reason: Identifies _matchIncomingOrder in CLOB.sol and matchedAmount logic for quote-denominated fill orders.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: baseDelta != matchedBase due to lot-size flooring, causing matchedAmount = takerOrder.amount instead of quoteDelta.

direct_effect.reason: Over-subtraction terminates matching prematurely; FOK marked filled despite dust unfilled; user receives fewer base tokens than quote should purchase.

safety_relation_basis.reason: FOK all-or-nothing guarantee violated and expected-vs-actual value relation (20% loss) derivable from stated numbers.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the lot-size flooring trigger, the premature termination and FOK violation effects, and provides a concrete expected-vs-actual safety relation with numeric example.
